blockers.detail: V8-12R-01 emptied internal/delivery/parity/ledger.go (the one failing final gate of the last real assessment, commit 6d3bab4: 15 debt entries -> 0, with TestParityLedgerIsEmpty green), but the V8-11 Alpha gate has not yet been run on a commit that contains that change, so no assessment says gatePass=true. The summary, assessed commit, run and checksums recorded here are those of the last real assessment and are deliberately not rewritten by hand.

nextTasks.scope: Take the `v8-alpha-assessment` artifact of the `v8-alpha-gate` job on the merged V8-12R-01 commit and record its assessed commit, run and the `aw-release-build` checksums in this file, the release report and start-here section 4A. Nothing else is required for ALPHA_READY.
